ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement"), is made thisβ day of October 2012,by and between August H. Lawrence Co. LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address at 96 Greenwich Street, New York, NY 10006 (hereinafter referred to as "Owner") and McSam Downtown LLC, a New York Limited Liability Company having an address at 420 Great Neck Road, Great Neck, NY 11021 (hereinafter referred to as "Developer"). said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements located thereon,in the County of NewYork, City and State of NewYork,known asandbythestreetaddress99WashingtonStreetandthetaxlotBlock53,Lot2andmore particularly described inSchedule B annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax WHEREAS, Developer is constructing on Developer's Land a new building, said new buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as (the “New Building"), said Developer's Land and the New Building being hereinafter referred to as "Developer's Property"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (herein referred to as"Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961,as amended from time to time (the "Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained within the Zoning Resolution upon Developer's Land; WHEREAS, there exists Floor Area Development Rights which are appurtenant to the Owner's Land and which are not utilized by the Owner's Building or retained by the Owner, and Owner desires to make such Excess Floor Area Development Rights (as defined herein) available for use on the Developer's Property and within the New Building pursuant to the Zoning Resolution;
